subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Should this aggregate Discord restart/recovery report stay open as the coordinating tracker, or should maintainers close it after moving each remaining symptom to focused canonical issues?
rationale: Current main only partially fixes reconnect and pre-connect delivery loss; the remaining behavior requires maintainer policy on provider-history replay, ambiguous-send reconciliation, duplicate-send safety, and diagnostics ownership.

options.title: Keep as coordinating tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until the Discord missed-inbound, final-delivery, and recovery-diagnostic slices have owner-approved fixes or explicit canonical handoffs.

options.title: Split and close as duplicates
options.body: Close this issue only after preserving its unique v2026.6.10 evidence on the focused canonical issues for inbound catch-up, durable final delivery, and Discord recovery.

options.title: Sponsor one Discord reliability project
options.body: Treat the issue as a broader project and assign an owner to land a single coordinated Discord restart/recovery hardening plan with live proof.

recommendation.title: Keep as coordinating tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the Discord missed-inbound, final-delivery, and recovery-diagnostic slices have owner-approved fixes or explicit canonical handoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is closest to the shared delivery/channel lifecycle boundary and product decision about replay versus duplicate-send safety.
